Artemis asks you to kill a cruel dwarf called Thorgrim Beastlasher.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = ranger
}}

===Objectives===
* Track down and destroy [[Thorgrim Beastlasher]] in [[Iron Horse Mine]].
* Return to [[Artemis the Ranger]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 350 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Whirling Defense}}
* {{skill icon|Winter}}
* {{skill icon|Call of Protection}}

==Walkthrough==
Make your way through [[Traveler's Vale]] towards [[Iron Horse Mine]] and you will find [[Artemis the Ranger]] by the metal bridge close to the [[portal]].

After accepting the quest, enter Iron Horse Mine and head north. You will soon find [[Thorgrim Beastlasher]] and a group of three [[Summit Beastmaster]]s. It is possible to [[pull]] Thorgrim alone, but if you [[aggro]] the whole group, be careful of their [[knockdown]] skills, [[Bull's Strike]] and [[Giant Stomp]]. Once Thorgrim is dead, return to Artemis to receive the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Artemis the Ranger
:''"These mountains can be a cruel place, and no creature personifies that cruelty more than the [[Stone Summit]] Dwarves. The Stone Summit go so far as to capture and bind the massive [[snow beast]]s of the Shiverpeaks to their will. Starved and enraged into a feral madness, these creatures carry the Dwarves into battle. The leader of these self-proclaimed Beastmasters is a foul Dwarf called '''Thorgrim Beastlasher'''. It would please Melandru if one of her Rangers would put an end to Thorgrim's depredations."''

:''"What say you, <Character name>? Are you up to the task?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = For Melandru!
| decline = I am not ready for such a task.
| ask = '''Thorgrim Beastlasher''' can be found in the area known as '''Iron Horse Mine''' to the north.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Aidan:''' ''"Hello there, friends! You look like you could use a hand against these brutes."''
:'''Aidan:''' ''"Melandru guide my bow!"''
:'''Aidan:''' ''"Well fought! I hope you don't mind my interference. I've been scouting paths through these mountains for quite some time and yours are the first friendly faces I've seen. If you'll excuse me, I must continue onward. I promised [[Devona]] that I would meet her, and I'm late. Until we meet again, may Melandru guide you."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Artemis the Ranger
:''"Thorgrim is dead, then? Well done! Perhaps some of these Beastmasters will abandon their trade when they hear of the justice Melandru brings to those who defile her domain. The Goddess must be pleased to know she has a mighty servant such as you to champion her cause."''

==Notes==
* Because of her low level, Artemis can easily be killed by nearby Stone Summit. If this happens, use the Iron Horse Mine portal to reset.
* Combines well with the [[Helping the Dwarves]] quest arc since it leads you past Artemis to get to [[Rangil Ironbow]] and the mine where [[Minaar Stonesledge]] is being held is just a bit further down the path.
** The [[monk]] quest [[The Wayward Monk]] also leads to the same area.
